haki.evidence: In the Corrida Colosseum B Block he senses Elizabello II's King Punch coming with his back turned (ch. 708).
He hardens his fist to break through Luffy's Haki-coated abs in the Dressrosa palace (ch. 770).
At the wedding tea party she knocks out a guest with Supreme King Haki for asking about Mother Carmel (ch. 861).
She blocks Luffy's Kong Gun with a hardened arm (ch. 871), the wiki's earliest cited use.
She gauges Enma's power and warns Kaidou to dodge Zoro's attack (ch. 1002).

results.note: The wiki also hangs a ch. 859 citation on her Supreme King Haki mastery, but ch. 859 only covers Bege's assassination briefing; the first on-page display is ch. 861.

haki.evidence: Enel explains his Mantra and how the Goro Goro no Mi extends it across Skypiea (ch. 278).

results.note: Scraped hint was null. Mantra is only retroactively named as Observation Haki (ch. 597). Earlier precognitive feats exist - predicting the Survival Game's five survivors (ch. 256) and spotting Nami hiding (ch. 273) - but Mantra is not attributed to him on-page until ch. 278, so that is the conservative pick.

haki.evidence: He clashes head-on with the Logia-powered Sabo using Haki (ch. 752); the black-coated blade is explicit by ch. 788.
Blind, he deflects a fragment of his own summoned meteor and fights Law without difficulty (ch. 713).

results.note: Corrected Observation from the scraped 799 to 713, the earliest chapter the wiki cites for his Observation feats. Weaker earlier hints exist at ch. 701-702 (the roulette scene), but there he is deceived, so it is not a clean display.
